description.value: A family-run private park sitting directly on Nimpo Lake—BC's self-styled floatplane capital—with free showers, laundry, and Wi-Fi making it a comfortable base for fishing, paddling, and Rainbow Mountains hikes 30 minutes away. Tent sites are $40/night at a seasonal operation that closes October 1.

address.value: 1891 Otter Road, Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Vagabond RV Park is an active lakefront campground on Nimpo Lake offering tent sites, 22 full-hookup RV sites, a yurt, and two log cabins. Free showers and laundry (washer/dryer in the shower house) are explicitly described on both the front page and RV sites subpage; a booking form on the contact page confirms reservations are accepted. The OSM primary phone (+1-250-742-3347) matches the website; the website additionally provides a full civic address (1891 Otter Road, Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0) absent from OSM.
concerns: OSM record has no address field populated; full civic address (1891 Otter Road, Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0) sourced from website and used in listing.
Website lists a second phone number (1-778-899-9991) not present in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active lakefront campground with tent sites, RV hookups, cabins, and a yurt in a remote but accessible BC wilderness area; a genuine and useful overnight option for touring cyclists on the Highway 20 corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Mountain biking is explicitly listed as a local activity on the activities subpage. A fish-cleaning room is noted near the lake.

wow_evidence: Free showers and laundry (washer/dryer in the shower house) are explicitly described
